  AGENDA
  Advisory Committee/Naming of a Public Facility or Street

  OPENING CEREMONIES – 11:00 A.M.

  Call to Order

  Roll Call

  PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEMS

  Persons wishing to address the Advisory Committee for Naming a Facility or Street, may do so at this
  time.
 City of Inglewood Meeting of the Advisory Committee for Naming a Facility  February 19, 2020
or Street

 PUBLIC HEARING
  PH-1. HOLLYWOOD PARK
  Public hearing to consider the request from Hollywood Park proposed Street Names, the
  locations of which are depicted upon the site plan enclosed herewith:
  1. Barca Drive

  2. Bluff Parkway

  3. Champions Way

  4. District Drive

  5. Highland Drive

  6. Lake Park Avenue

  7. Marquee Drive

  8. Scipio Drive

  9. Stadium Drive

  10. Touchdown Drive

  11. Varus Drive

  12. Victory Street
  Recommendation:
  1) Receive input from requestor;
  2) Receive public comments;
  3) Approve application submitted by Hollywood Park; and
  4) Direct City Clerk to present the findings to the City Council at the appropriate
  meeting.

 PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS

 Persons wishing to address the City Council on any matter connected with City business not elsewhere
 considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Persons with complaints regarding City management or
 departmental operations are requested to submit those complaints first to the City Manager for
 resolution.

 ADVISORY COMMITTEE COMMENTS

 The members of the City Council will provide oral reports, including reports on City related travels
 where lodging expenses are incurred, and/or address any matters they deem of general interest to the
 public.

 ADJOURNMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE

  -2-
 City of Inglewood Meeting of the Advisory Committee for Naming a Facility  February 19, 2020
or Street

 In the event that today’s meeting of the Advisory Committee for Naming a Facility or Street is not held,
 or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item being considered, the public hearing or
 non-public hearing agenda item will automatically be continued to the next regularly scheduled Advisory
 Committee meeting. If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, or need translation
 services, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (310) 412-5280 or FAX (310) 412-5533, One
 Manchester Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests for special
 accommodations must be received 72 hours prior to the day of the Council Meetings.
